opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowship Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career historians within five years of submitting their corrected doctoral thesis in a historical subject to a UK institution; normally resident in the UK; not in permanent full-time academic employment; current members of the Royal Historical Society. Current doctoral students not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £2,000 for discrete career-building research projects or activities lasting no more than six months, supporting early career historians to produce a discrete outcome such as an article or book proposal.

opportunities.title: Martin Lynn Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members of the Royal Historical Society currently studying for a PhD in African history. Those previously awarded the Scholarship not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Annual scholarship of £1,500 to support the doctoral research of a postgraduate researcher in African history.

opportunities.title: Open Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to all historians who are members of the Royal Historical Society and who are not postgraduate students or early career researchers (within 5 years of completing a PhD).
opportunities.summary: Grants of either £500 or £1,000 to support historians without access to research funding to visit archives, historical sites, conduct interviews, and attend conferences.

opportunities.title: Postgraduate Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be current Postgraduate Members of the Royal Historical Society studying for a Master's degree or PhD in History. Not open to those who have completed their doctorate.
opportunities.summary: Grants of either £500 or £1,000 to postgraduate historians to undertake historical research, including visiting archives or historic sites and conducting interviews.

opportunities.title: Early Career Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career historians within five years of submitting their corrected doctoral thesis in a historical subject, who are current members of the Royal Historical Society.
opportunities.summary: Grants of either £500 or £1,000 to early career historians to undertake research, including visiting archives or historic sites and conducting interviews.

opportunities.title: David Berry Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current Fellows and Members of the Royal Historical Society at all career stages, from PhD research and beyond.
opportunities.summary: Annual award of up to £2,500 to undertake research into the history of Scotland and/or the Scottish people within the United Kingdom or worldwide.

opportunities.title: RHS Workshop Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants/lead organisers must be current Fellows or members of the Royal Historical Society.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £1,000 to enable historians to come together for a day event to pursue projects of shared interest, including research discussion, teaching development, networking and grant planning.
